## Codes du stage

Chaque grande partie correspond à une simulation.

## Comparatif HSIC vs Sobol

### G-function

```{r}

plan(multisession, workers = 6)
set.seed(443)
gfunc_a99 <- function(xx){
  d <- length(xx)
  a <- (seq_len(d) -1) / 2
  a[1] <- 99 #X1 rendu non influent
  prod((abs(4*xx - 2) + a) / (1 + a))}
gfunc_a99_vec <- function(X) apply(X, 1, gfunc_a99)

d_grid=c(5, 10, 20)
n_grid=c(100, 500, 1000)
n_reps=30
grid_rep=expand.grid(d=d_grid, n=n_grid, rep=seq_len(n_reps))
make_samples <- function(d, n) {
  list(
    X  = as.data.frame(matrix(runif(n * d), nrow = n, ncol = d, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", seq_len(d))))),
    X1 = as.data.frame(matrix(runif(n * d), nrow = n, ncol = d, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", seq_len(d))))),
    X2 = as.data.frame(matrix(runif(n * d), nrow = n, ncol = d, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", seq_len(d))))))}


tic("pipeline complet")
df_all <- future_map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(grid_rep)), function(i){
  d=grid_rep$d[i]
  n=grid_rep$n[i]
  rep =grid_rep$rep[i]
  s=make_samples(d, n)
  #sobol
  sob=sobol2002(model = gfunc_a99_vec, X1 = s$X1, X2 = s$X2, nboot = 0)
  df_s1=data.frame(method = "Sobol S1", d = d, n = n, rep = rep,
                      variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                      value    = sob$S[, "original"])
  df_st=data.frame(method = "Sobol ST", d = d, n = n, rep = rep,
                      variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                      value    = sob$T[, "original"])

  #hsic
  sensi=sensiHSIC(model= gfunc_a99_vec,
    X = as.matrix(s$X),kernelX = "rbf",kernelY = "rbf",
    nboot= 0,save.GM = list(KX = TRUE, KY = TRUE))
  
  #tests
  pvalsperm=testHSIC(sensi = sensi,test.method = "Permutation",B=199)$pval[, "original"]
  pvalsasymp=testHSIC(sensi = sensi, test.method ="Asymptotic",B=199)$pval[, "original"]

  
  df_hsic <- data.frame(method = "R2-HSIC", d=d, n=n, rep=rep,
                        variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                        value = sensi$S[, "original"])
  df_perm <- data.frame(method = "pval_perm", d=d, n=n, rep=rep,
                        variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                        value = pvalsperm)
  df_asymp <- data.frame(method = "pval_asymp", d=d, n=n, rep=rep,
                         variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                         value = pvalsasymp)
  df_out <- bind_rows(df_s1, df_st, df_hsic, df_perm, df_asymp)
  df_out}, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE), .progress = TRUE)
toc()
vars_all = unique(df_all$variable)
ord_var = vars_all[order(as.numeric(gsub("X", "", vars_all)))]
df_all$variable = factor(df_all$variable, levels = ord_var)

```

### Friedman indépendant

```{r}

friedman <- function(xx) {
  10 * sin(pi * xx[1] * xx[2]) + 20 * (xx[3] - 0.5)^2 + 10 * xx[4] + 5 * xx[5]
}
friedman_vec <- function(X) apply(X, 1, friedman)
plan(multisession, workers = 6)

  d   <- length(xx)
  a   <- (seq_len(d) - 1) / 2
  a[1] <- 99          # X1 rendu non influent
  prod((abs(4*xx - 2) + a) / (1 + a))}
gfunc_a99_vec <- function(X) apply(X, 1, gfunc_a99)
```

### Friedman dépendant

```{r}

make_samples <- function(d, n, rho=0.7){
  Sigma=diag(d)
  Sigma[1, 3]=rho
  Sigma[3, 1]=rho
  X=mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, d), Sigma = Sigma)
  X1=mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, d), Sigma = Sigma)
  X2=mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, d), Sigma = Sigma)
  colnames(X)=paste0("X", seq_len(d))
  colnames(X1)=paste0("X", seq_len(d))
  colnames(X2)=paste0("X", seq_len(d))
  list(X= as.data.frame(X),X1 = as.data.frame(X1),X2 = as.data.frame(X2))}


friedman <- function(xx) {
  10 * sin(pi * xx[1] * xx[2]) + 20 * (xx[3] - 0.5)^2 + 10 * xx[4] + 5 * xx[5]
}
friedman_vec <- function(X) apply(X, 1, friedman)

                      variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                      value    = sob$S[, "original"])
  df_st=data.frame(method = "Sobol ST", d = d, n = n, rep = rep,
                      variable = paste0("X", seq_len(d)),
                      value    = sob$T[, "original"])

  #hsic
  sensi=sensiHSIC(model= friedman_vec,

  #tests

  pvalsasymp=testHSIC(sensi = sensi, test.method ="Asymptotic",B=199)$pval[, "original"]

  
  df_hsic <- data.frame(method = "R2-HSIC", d=d, n=n, rep=rep,
```

### Visualisation

```{r}
plot_sobol_d = function(dd,df_all) {
  df_tmp = df_all %>%
    filter(method %in% c("Sobol S1", "Sobol ST"), d == dd) %>%
    mutate(
      n = factor(n, levels = c(100, 500, 1000)),
      method = factor(method, levels = c("Sobol S1", "Sobol ST"))
    )
  
  ggplot(df_tmp, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = method),
      alpha = 0.5,
      size = 1,
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ n, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sobol S1" = "#1f77b4", "Sobol ST" = "#ff7f0e")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Sobol S1" = "#1f77b4", "Sobol ST" = "#ff7f0e")) +
    labs(title = paste0("Indices de Sobol - d = ", dd),
         x = NULL, y = "Valeur de l'indice", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "top")}

plot_hsic_d = function(dd,df_all) {
  df_tmp = df_all %>%
    filter(method == "R2-HSIC", d == dd) %>%
    mutate(n = factor(n, levels = c(100, 500, 1000)))
  
  ggplot(df_tmp, aes(x = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#7570b3", alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~ n, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
    labs(title = paste0("R²-HSIC - d = ", dd),
         x = NULL, y = "R²-HSIC") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))}

plot_pval_boxplot <- function(dd, df_all, subtitle = "") {
  df_all |>
    filter(method %in% c("pval_perm", "pval_asymp"), d == dd) |>
    mutate(
      variable     = factor(as.character(variable),
                            levels = paste0("X", seq_len(dd))),
      n_label      = factor(paste0("n = ", n),
                            levels = paste0("n = ", sort(unique(n)))),
      method_label = factor(
        ifelse(method == "pval_perm", "Permutation", "Asymptotique"),
        levels = c("Permutation", "Asymptotique"))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = method_label)) +
    geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.3, outlier.size = 0.4,
                 alpha = 0.85, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Permutation"  = "#1f77b4",
                                 "Asymptotique" = "#d62728"),
                      name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
    facet_wrap(~ n_label, nrow = 1) +
    labs(title    = paste0("Distribution des p-valeurs HSIC - d=", D,
                           " - 30 rép."),
         subtitle = subtitle,
         x = NULL, y = "p-valeur") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position  = "top",
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))}

#gfunc
d_grid=c(5,10)
for (d in d_grid){
print(plot_sobol_d(d,df_all))
print(plot_pval_boxplot(D=d,df_all=df_all,subtitle = "X1 est non influent"))}

#friedmanind
d_grid=6
plot_sobol_d(6,df_all=df_all_friedman)
plot_hsic_d(6,df_all=df_all_friedman)
plot_pval_boxplot(D = 6, df_all = df_all_friedman,
                  subtitle = "Friedman - X6 muet")

#friedmandep
plot_sobol_d(6,df_all=df_all_friedman_dep)
plot_hsic_d(6,df_all=df_all_friedman_dep)
plot_pval_boxplot(D = 6, df_all = df_all_friedman_dep,
                  subtitle = "Friedman - X6 muet, dépendance entre X1 et X3")
```

### HSIC ANOVA

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/kulu/OneDrive - ifpen.fr/Documents/Premières simulations_files")

X_all <- martheinput %>%
  dplyr::select(per1, per2, per3, perz1, perz2, perz3, perz4,
                d1, d2, d3, dt1, dt2, dt3,
                kd1, kd2, kd3, poros, i1, i2, i3)

group_map <- list(
  per1 = c("per1"),
  per2 = c("per2"),
  per3 = c("per3"),
  perz1 = c("perz1"),
  perz2 = c("perz2"),
  perz3 = c("perz3"),
  perz4 = c("perz4"),
  d1_group = c("d1", "dt1"),
  d2_group = c("d2", "dt2"),
  d3_group = c("d3", "dt3"),
  kd1 = c("kd1"),
  kd2 = c("kd2"),
  kd3 = c("kd3"),
  poros = c("poros"),
  i_group = c("i1", "i2", "i3"))

n=nrow(X_all)
output_names=colnames(martheoutput)
group_names=names(group_map)

#Fonctions auxiliaires
make_gramHSIC_from_list <- function(K_list) {
  n  <- nrow(K_list[[1]])
  p  <- length(K_list)
  KX <- array(NA_real_, c(n, n, p))
  for (i in seq_len(p)) KX[,,i] <- K_list[[i]]
  obj <- list(KX = KX)
  class(obj) <- "gramHSIC"
  obj}

#Produit de noyaux pour les groupes
group_product_kernel <- function(KX_array, var_indices) {
  Reduce("*", lapply(var_indices, function(i) KX_array[,,i]))}



#Codes pour les graphiques
plot_heatmap <- function(mat, titre, fill_label = "R² HSIC") {
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(mat))
  colnames(df) <- c("Var", "Output", "val")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Output, y = Var, fill = val)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(val, 5)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4472C4") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = titre, fill = fill_label) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))}

plot_pval <- function(mat, titre) {
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(mat))
  colnames(df) <- c("Var", "Output", "val")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Output, y = Var, fill = val)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(val, 2)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#C00000", mid = "white", high = "#CFCFCF",
                         midpoint = 0.05) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = titre, fill = "p-valeur") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))}

#Extraction d'une matrice résultat depuis une liste de sensiHSIC
extract_mat <- function(res_list, slot, rownames_vec, colnames_vec) {
  mat <- sapply(colnames_vec, function(y) res_list[[y]][[slot]][, "original"])
  rownames(mat) <- rownames_vec
  mat}

#Test de permutation via les matrices KY sauvegardées
perm_test_from_gram <- function(KX_group, KY, B = 200) {
  n   <- nrow(KX_group)
  H   <- diag(n) - matrix(1/n, n, n)
  obs <- sum((H %*% KX_group %*% H) * (H %*% KY %*% H)) / (n - 1)^2
  perm_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(n)
    sum((H %*% KX_group %*% H) * (H %*% KY[idx, idx] %*% H)) / (n - 1)^2
  })
  (sum(perm_vals >= obs) + 1) / (B + 1)}

n =nrow(X_all)
group_names=names(group_map)
X_mat=as.matrix(X_all)
var_names=colnames(X_all)

#Indices de colonnes par groupe
group_idx <- lapply(group_map, function(vars) which(var_names %in% vars))

#Calcul des noyaux
precompute_KX <- function(X_mat, kernelX, y_vec, anova_obj = "no") {
  sv <- sensitivity::sensiHSIC(
    model   = NULL,
    X       = X_mat,
    kernelX = kernelX,
    paramX  = NA,
    kernelY = "rbf",
    paramY  = NA,
    anova   = list(obj = anova_obj, is.uniform = FALSE),
    nboot   = 0,
    save.GM = list(KX = TRUE, KY = TRUE))
  tell(sv, y = matrix(y_vec))}

# On précalcule sur la première sortie pour récupérer KX
# (KX ne dépend pas de Y, on peut le réutiliser pour toutes les sorties)
sv_rbf=precompute_KX(X_mat, "rbf",        martheoutput[[1]])
sv_rbf_anova=precompute_KX(X_mat, "rbf_anova",  martheoutput[[1]], "both")
sv_m32=precompute_KX(X_mat, "matern3",    martheoutput[[1]])
sv_m32_anova=precompute_KX(X_mat, "matern3_anova", martheoutput[[1]], "both")

KX_rbf=sv_rbf$KX
KX_rbf_anova=sv_rbf_anova$KX
KX_m32=sv_m32$KX
KX_m32_anova=sv_m32_anova$KX

#noyaux de groupes

K_grp_rbf_prod       <- lapply(group_idx, group_product_kernel, KX_array = KX_rbf)
K_grp_m32_prod       <- lapply(group_idx, group_product_kernel, KX_array = KX_m32)
K_grp_rbf_anova_prod <- lapply(group_idx, group_product_kernel, KX_array = KX_rbf_anova)
K_grp_m32_anova_prod <- lapply(group_idx, group_product_kernel, KX_array = KX_m32_anova)
```

### HSIC Shapley

```{r}
#calcul

run_group_analysis=function(K_groups, Y_vec,
                                kernelY  = "rbf",
                                anova    = list(obj = "no", is.uniform = FALSE)) {
  p       <- length(K_groups)
  X_dummy <- matrix(seq_len(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p)
  kX      <- if (anova$obj != "no") "rbf_anova" else "rbf"
  gram    <- make_gramHSIC_from_list(K_groups)

  sv <- sensitivity::sensiHSIC(
    model   = NULL,
    X       = X_dummy,
    kernelX = kX,
    paramX  = NA,
    kernelY = kernelY,
    paramY  = NA,
    anova   = anova,
    sensi   = gram,
    nboot   = 0,
    save.GM = list(KX = FALSE, KY = TRUE)
  )
  tell(sv, y = matrix(Y_vec))
}

# ── RBF produit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
res_grp_rbf <- lapply(output_names, function(y)
  run_group_analysis(K_grp_rbf_prod, martheoutput[[y]], kernelY = "rbf"))
names(res_grp_rbf) <- output_names

# ── Matern 3/2 produit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
res_grp_m32 <- lapply(output_names, function(y)
  run_group_analysis(K_grp_m32_prod, martheoutput[[y]], kernelY = "matern3"))
names(res_grp_m32) <- output_names

# ── RBF ANOVA produit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
res_grp_rbf_anova <- lapply(output_names, function(y)
  run_group_analysis(K_grp_rbf_anova_prod, martheoutput[[y]],
                     kernelY = "rbf",
                     anova   = list(obj = "both", is.uniform = FALSE)))
names(res_grp_rbf_anova) <- output_names

# ── Matern 3/2 ANOVA produit ──────────────────────────────────────────────
res_grp_m32_anova <- lapply(output_names, function(y)
  run_group_analysis(K_grp_m32_anova_prod, martheoutput[[y]],
                     kernelY = "rbf",
                     anova   = list(obj = "both", is.uniform = FALSE)))
names(res_grp_m32_anova) <- output_names

run_pvals <- function(res_list, K_groups, B = 200) {
  mat <- matrix(NA, length(group_names), length(output_names),
                dimnames = list(group_names, output_names))
  for (y in output_names) {
    KY <- res_list[[y]]$KY
    for (g in seq_along(group_names))
      mat[g, y] <- perm_test_from_gram(K_groups[[g]], KY, B)}
  mat}

# ── RBF ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_grp_rbf    <- extract_mat(res_grp_rbf, "S", group_names, output_names)
pvals_grp_rbf <- run_pvals(res_grp_rbf, K_grp_rbf_prod)
plot_heatmap(r2_grp_rbf,    "R² HSIC groupes - RBF produit")
plot_pval(pvals_grp_rbf,    "p-valeurs HSIC groupes - RBF produit")

# ── Matern 3/2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_grp_m32    <- extract_mat(res_grp_m32, "S", group_names, output_names)
pvals_grp_m32 <- run_pvals(res_grp_m32, K_grp_m32_prod)
plot_heatmap(r2_grp_m32,    "R² HSIC groupes - Matern 3/2 produit")
plot_pval(pvals_grp_m32,    "p-valeurs HSIC groupes - Matern 3/2 produit")

# ── RBF ANOVA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_grp_rbf_anova <- extract_mat(res_grp_rbf_anova, "S",  group_names, output_names)
fo_grp_rbf_anova <- extract_mat(res_grp_rbf_anova, "FO", group_names, output_names)
to_grp_rbf_anova <- extract_mat(res_grp_rbf_anova, "TO", group_names, output_names)
```

```{r}
#fonctions hsic perso
#fonctions hsic 
#rbf normal
rbf_kernel_1d=function(x, sigma = NULL) {
  x=as.numeric(x)
  n=length(x)
  D2=as.matrix(dist(x))^2 #norm eucl
  if (is.null(sigma)) {
    med=median(D2[D2 > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    sigma=sqrt(med / 2)
    if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) sigma =1
  }
  exp(-D2/(2 * sigma^2))}

#produit noyaux
product_kernel=function(X,kerfun) {
  col_names <- colnames(X)
  K <- NULL
  for (v in col_names) {
    Kv <- kerfun(as.numeric(X[, v]))
    K  <- if (is.null(K)) Kv else K * Kv
  }
  d <- sqrt(diag(K))
  K / outer(d, d)
}
#somme noyaux
sum_kernel=function(X,kerfun) {
  col_names <- colnames(X)
  K <- NULL
  for (v in col_names) {
    Kv <- kerfun(as.numeric(X[, v]))
    K  <- if (is.null(K)) Kv else K + Kv
  }
  d <- sqrt(diag(K))
  K / outer(d, d)
}

#hsic
hsic=function(Kx, Ky) {
  n=nrow(Kx)
  H=diag(n) -matrix(1/n, n,n)
  Kc=H %*% Kx %*% H
  Lc=H %*% Ky %*% H
  sum(Kc * Lc) / ((n - 1)^2)} #somme du produit de hadamard= trace en moins couteux

#fonctions test permutations
hsic_perm_test=function(Kx,Ky,B=500) {
  n=nrow(Kx)
  obs=hsic(Kx, Ky)
  perm_vals=replicate(B,{
    idx=sample(n)
    hsic(Kx, Ky[idx, idx])})
  p_val <- (sum(perm_vals >= obs) + 1) / (B + 1)
  list(statistic = obs, p_value = p_val)
}

#hsic shapley
shapley_hsic_mc=function(group_map, X_all, Y,
                            m      = 200,
                            kerfun = rbf_kernel_1d) {
  d=length(group_map)
  group_names=names(group_map)
  n=nrow(X_all)
  H=diag(n) - matrix(1/n, n, n)
  Ky=kerfun(Y)
  Kyc=H %*% Ky %*% H

  # hsic_clean définie DANS la fonction pour capturer H et Kyc et optimiser du temps de calcul (on calculait aussi Kyc sinon avec lautre fonction)
  hsic_clean=function(Kx) {
    Kxc=H%*%Kx%*%H
    (sum(Kxc * Kyc))/(n - 1)^2
  }
  #noyaux RBF de chaque groupe
  K_list <-lapply(group_map, function(vars)
    product_kernel(X_all[, vars, drop = FALSE], kerfun = kerfun))

  # HSIC(X,Yi) noyau produit sur toutes les variables
  vars_all <- unlist(group_map, use.names = FALSE)
  K_all    <- product_kernel(X_all[, vars_all, drop = FALSE], kerfun = kerfun)
  hsic_tot <- hsic_clean(K_all)

  if (hsic_tot <= 0) return(setNames(rep(0, d), group_names))

  contrib=numeric(d) #initialisation de la somme
  # tirage de toutes les permutations en une fois
  perms=replicate(m, sample(d))
  for (i in seq_len(m)) { #on définit les permutations et initialise la boucle
    pi_i=perms[, i]
    K_prev =NULL
    hsic_prev=0

    for (j in seq_len(d)) { #calcul de la somme
      l=pi_i[j]
      K_curr=if (is.null(K_prev)) K_list[[l]] else K_prev * K_list[[l]]
      hsic_curr=hsic_clean(K_curr)

      contrib[l]=contrib[l]+(hsic_curr - hsic_prev)
      K_prev=K_curr
      hsic_prev=hsic_curr
    }
  }
  Sh <- (contrib / m) / hsic_tot
  names(Sh)=group_names
  Sh
}

set.seed(443)
sh_marthe_mc <- lapply(output_names, function(y) {
  cat("=== Sortie :", y, "===\n")
  shapley_hsic_mc(
    group_map = group_map,
    X_all     = X_all,
    Y         = martheoutput[[y]],
    m         = 200,
    kerfun    = rbf_kernel_1d)
})
names(sh_marthe_mc) <- output_names

# vérification somme = 1
cat("\nVérification somme des Sh par sortie :\n")
print(sapply(output_names, function(y) round(sum(sh_marthe_mc[[y]]), 4)))


sh_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(output_names, function(y) {
  data.frame(
    groupe = names(sh_marthe_mc[[y]]),
    valeur = as.numeric(sh_marthe_mc[[y]]),
    sortie = y)
}))

make_sh_plot <- function(y) {
  df       <- sh_df[sh_df$sortie == y, ]
  ymin     <- min(0, min(df$valeur, na.rm = TRUE)) * 1.3
  ymax     <- max(0, max(df$valeur, na.rm = TRUE)) * 1.3
  df$hjust <- ifelse(df$valeur >= 0, -0.1, 1.1)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(groupe, valeur), y = valeur, fill = valeur >= 0)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(valeur, 4), hjust = hjust), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4C8BE0", "FALSE" = "#E05C4C")) +
    coord_flip() +
    ylim(ymin, ymax) +
    labs(title = y, x = NULL, y = "Sh") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}

for (y in output_names) {
  print(make_sh_plot(y))
}
```

# Système multi-niveaux

On cherche à tansformer le système multi-niveaux en un système à 1 niveau en "condensant" l'information des X et Y dans le système, par exemple de la manière suivante.

On part sur une optique non-paramétrique.

![![](images/clipboard-4203486573.png)](images/clipboard-4250267876.png)

### Système de Xu

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(rvinecopulib)
library(sensitivity)
library(gtools)

#données
set.seed(443)
n = 1000
X1 = rnorm(n, mean = 1, sd = sqrt(0.1))
X2 = rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = sqrt(0.1))
X3 = rnorm(n, mean = 3, sd = sqrt(0.1))
X4 = rnorm(n, mean = 4, sd = sqrt(0.1))

nu = 2
omega = 2

## sous-systèmes niveau bas
Y1 = 2 * X1 + (-X1 * X2) * nu + 10 * X3
Y2 = X1^2 + 2 * X2
Y3 = 3 * X1 + sqrt(X2)

## sous-système niveau haut
Z = X4 * Y1^omega + X4^2 * Y2^omega + 2 * X4^2 * Y3^omega + 10 * X4^2 * X3^omega

vars_all = data.frame(X1 = X1, X2 = X2, X3 = X3, X4 = X4,
                      Y1 = Y1, Y2 = Y2, Y3 = Y3, Z = Z)

vars_all = as.data.frame(vars_all)
colnames(vars_all) = trimws(colnames(vars_all))

vn_all = colnames(vars_all)
X_vars = c("X1", "X2", "X3", "X4")
Y_vars = c("Y1", "Y2", "Y3")
tau_threshold = 0.10

get_col = function(df, nm) as.numeric(df[[nm]])
X_all = sapply(X_vars, get_col, df = vars_all)

## on recupere les variables influentes
U_all = pseudo_obs(as.matrix(vars_all))
pipeline_hierarchique2 <- function( #fonction qui sert à faire le diagnostic sur le niveau X Z dans les 4 cas du système de xu et al
  vars_all,
  X_vars = c("X1", "X2", "X3", "X4"),
  model_Y1_fn = function(X, nu) {
    2 * X[, 1] - nu * X[, 1] * X[, 2] + 10 * X[, 3]
  },
  model_Y2_fn = function(X, nu) {
    X[, 1]^2 + 2 * X[, 2]
  },
  model_Y3_fn = function(X, nu) {
    3 * X[, 1] + sqrt(abs(X[, 2]))
  },
  g_fun = function(X3, X4, Y1, Y2, Y3, omega) {
    X4 * Y1^omega +
      X4^2 * Y2^omega +
      2 * X4^2 * Y3^omega +
      10 * X4^2 * X3^omega
  },
  nu = 2,
  omega = 2,
  leave_one_out = TRUE,
  No = 50,
  Ni = 3,
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = 443
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # ==========================================================================
  # Fonctions auxiliaires
  # ==========================================================================

  get_col <- function(x, col) {
    x <- as.matrix(x)

    if (ncol(x) < col) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(x)))
    }

    as.numeric(x[, col])
  }

  bandwidth_silverman <- function(n, d) {
    n^(-1 / (d + 4))
  }

  pseudo_obs_manual <- function(x) {
    x <- as.matrix(x)

    apply(x, 2, function(x_col) {
      rank(x_col) / (length(x_col) + 1)
    })
  }

  K_gauss <- function(u, U_ref, h) {
    U_ref <- as.matrix(U_ref)

    apply(U_ref, 1, function(u_ref) {
      prod(dnorm(u - u_ref, mean = 0, sd = h))
    })
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # Fonction de répartition conditionnelle estimée par KDE
  # ==========================================================================

  F_cond_kde <- function(v, u_X, U_Xs, u_Zs, h) {
    weights <- K_gauss(
      u = u_X,
      U_ref = U_Xs,
      h = h
    )

    weight_sum <- sum(weights)

    if (weight_sum < 1e-12) {
      return(v)
    }

    sum(weights * (u_Zs <= v)) / weight_sum
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # Quantile conditionnel estimé par inversion
  # ==========================================================================

  Q_cond_kde <- function(
    u_Z,
    u_X,
    U_Xs,
    u_Zs,
    h,
    tol = 1e-4
  ) {
    objective <- function(v) {
      F_cond_kde(
        v = v,
        u_X = u_X,
        U_Xs = U_Xs,
        u_Zs = u_Zs,
        h = h
      ) - u_Z
    }

    lower <- tol
    upper <- 1 - tol

    f_lower <- objective(lower)
    f_upper <- objective(upper)

    if (
      is.na(f_lower) ||
      is.na(f_upper) ||
      sign(f_lower) == sign(f_upper)
    ) {
      grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 200)
      values <- vapply(grid, objective, numeric(1))

      return(grid[which.min(abs(values))])
    }

    uniroot(
      f = objective,
      lower = lower,
      upper = upper,
      tol = tol
    )$root
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # Tirage conditionnel par rééchantillonnage pondéré
  # ==========================================================================

  sample_cond_kde <- function(
    Ni_s,
    U_target_ref,
    U_cond_ref,
    x_cond,
    h
  ) {
    U_target_ref <- as.matrix(U_target_ref)
    U_cond_ref <- as.matrix(U_cond_ref)

    n_ref <- nrow(U_cond_ref)

    if (is.null(x_cond) || length(x_cond) == 0L) {
      indices <- sample(
        seq_len(n_ref),
        size = Ni_s,
        replace = TRUE
      )

      return(
        list(
          idx = indices,
          vals = U_target_ref[indices, , drop = FALSE]
        )
      )
    }

    weights <- K_gauss(
      u = x_cond,
      U_ref = U_cond_ref,
      h = h
    )

    weight_sum <- sum(weights)

    if (weight_sum < 1e-12) {
      indices <- sample(
        seq_len(n_ref),
        size = Ni_s,
        replace = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      indices <- sample(
        seq_len(n_ref),
        size = Ni_s,
        replace = TRUE,
        prob = weights / weight_sum
      )
    }

    list(
      idx = indices,
      vals = U_target_ref[indices, , drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
  

  # ==========================================================================
  # Initialisation
  # ==========================================================================

  vars_all <- as.data.frame(vars_all)
  colnames(vars_all) <- trimws(colnames(vars_all))

  n <- nrow(vars_all)
  out <- list()

  if (!all(X_vars %in% colnames(vars_all))) {
    stop("Certaines variables de X_vars sont absentes de vars_all.")
  }

  if (!all(c("X3", "X4") %in% colnames(vars_all))) {
    stop("Les colonnes X3 et X4 doivent être présentes dans vars_all.")
  }

  if (No < 1 || Ni < 1) {
    stop("No et Ni doivent être strictement positifs.")
  }

  X_mat <- as.matrix(
    vars_all[, X_vars, drop = FALSE]
  )

  X3_vec <- as.numeric(vars_all[, "X3"])
  X4_vec <- as.numeric(vars_all[, "X4"])

  # Recalcul des sorties à partir des paramètres fournis
  Y1_calc <- model_Y1_fn(X_mat, nu)
  Y2_calc <- model_Y2_fn(X_mat, nu)
  Y3_calc <- model_Y3_fn(X_mat, nu)

  Z_vec <- g_fun(
    X3 = X3_vec,
    X4 = X4_vec,
    Y1 = Y1_calc,
    Y2 = Y2_calc,
    Y3 = Y3_calc,
    omega = omega
  )

  if (verbose) {
    cat("nu =", nu, "| omega =", omega, "\n")
    cat(
      "Z | moyenne =",
      round(mean(Z_vec), 4),
      "| écart-type =",
      round(sd(Z_vec), 4),
      "\n"
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # Pseudo-observations
  # ==========================================================================

  data_X <- as.data.frame(
    X_mat[, X_vars, drop = FALSE]
  )

  U_X <- pseudo_obs_manual(data_X)

  data_XZ <- cbind(
    data_X,
    Z = Z_vec
  )

  U_XZ <- pseudo_obs_manual(data_XZ)

  u_Zs <- U_XZ[, "Z"]
  U_Xs_Z <- U_XZ[, X_vars, drop = FALSE]

  xj_sel_Z <- X_vars
  out$xj_sel_Z <- xj_sel_Z

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bloc 1 (non obligatoire, surtout pr valider les reconstructions par une comparaison) : reconstruction de Z par inversion de F_{Z|X}
  # ==========================================================================

  d_x <- length(xj_sel_Z)
  h <- bandwidth_silverman(n, d_x)

  if (verbose) {
    cat(
      "\nDimension de X =",
      d_x,
      "| bande passante =",
      round(h, 4),
      "\n"
    )

    cat("Calcul de Z'...\n")
  }

  u_prime_Z <- numeric(n)

  progress_points <- unique(
    pmax(
      1L,
      floor(seq(1, n, length.out = 11))
    )
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    if (verbose && i %in% progress_points) {
      cat(
        round(100 * i / n),
        "% ",
        sep = ""
      )
    }

    ref <- if (leave_one_out) {
      setdiff(seq_len(n), i)
    } else {
      seq_len(n)
    }

    u_prime_Z[i] <- Q_cond_kde(
      u_Z = u_Zs[i],
      u_X = U_Xs_Z[i, ],
      U_Xs = U_Xs_Z[ref, , drop = FALSE],
      u_Zs = u_Zs[ref],
      h = h
    )
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat("\n")
  }

  u_prime_Z <- pmin(
    pmax(u_prime_Z, 1e-6),
    1 - 1e-6
  )

  Zprime <- as.numeric(
    quantile(
      Z_vec,
      probs = u_prime_Z,
      names = FALSE
    )
  )

  tau_ZZp <- cor(
    Z_vec,
    Zprime,
    method = "kendall",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )

  delta_Z <- ifelse(
    Z_vec == 0,
    NA_real_,
    (Zprime - Z_vec) / Z_vec
  )

  U_check <- pseudo_obs(
    cbind(Z_vec, Zprime)
  )

  fit_check <- bicop(
    U_check,
    family_set = "parametric",
    selcrit = "aic"
  )

  tau_cop <- fit_check$tau

  if (
    is.null(tau_cop) ||
    !is.numeric(tau_cop)
  ) {
    tau_cop <- cor(
      U_check[, 1],
      U_check[, 2],
      method = "kendall",
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat("\nDiagnostic Z ~ Z'\n")
    cat(
      "tau(Z, Z') =",
      round(tau_ZZp, 4),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Copule :",
      fit_check$family,
      "| tau =",
      round(tau_cop, 4),
      "\n"
    )
    print(summary(delta_Z))
  }

  out$Zprime <- Zprime
  out$tau_ZZp <- tau_ZZp
  out$delta_Z <- delta_Z
  out$copule_ZZp <- list(
    famille = fit_check$family,
    tau = round(tau_cop, 4)
  )

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bloc 2 : estimation des valeurs de Shapley X -> Z
  # ==========================================================================

  d_shap <- length(xj_sel_Z)
  h_shap <- bandwidth_silverman(n, d_shap)

  model_obj <- list(
    joueurs = xj_sel_Z,
    data_real = data_X,
    U_joueurs = U_X,
    Z_vec = Z_vec,
    h = h_shap,
    n = n
  )

  predict_fn <- function(obj, X) {
    X <- as.matrix(X)

    apply(X, 1, function(x_row) {
      u_x <- vapply(
        seq_along(x_row),
        function(k) {
          mean(obj$data_real[, k] <= x_row[k])
        },
        numeric(1)
      )

      u_x <- pmin(
        pmax(u_x, 1e-6),
        1 - 1e-6
      )

      weights <- K_gauss(
        u = u_x,
        U_ref = obj$U_joueurs,
        h = obj$h
      )

      weight_sum <- sum(weights)

      if (weight_sum < 1e-12) {
        return(mean(obj$Z_vec))
      }

      sum(weights * obj$Z_vec) / weight_sum
    })
  }

  Xall_fn <- function(n_samp) {
    indices <- sample(
      seq_len(n),
      size = n_samp,
      replace = TRUE
    )

    as.matrix(
      data_X[indices, , drop = FALSE]
    )
  }

  Xset_fn <- function(
    n_samp,
    Sj,
    Sjc,
    xjc
  ) {
    if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
      indices <- sample(
        seq_len(n),
        size = n_samp,
        replace = TRUE
      )

      out_mat <- as.matrix(
        data_X[indices, Sj, drop = FALSE]
      )

      colnames(out_mat) <- xj_sel_Z[Sj]

      return(out_mat)
    }

    u_Sjc <- vapply(
      seq_along(Sjc),
      function(k) {
        col_real <- data_X[, Sjc[k]]
        mean(col_real <= xjc[k])
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    u_Sjc <- pmin(
      pmax(u_Sjc, 1e-6),
      1 - 1e-6
    )

    draw <- sample_cond_kde(
      Ni_s = n_samp,
      U_target_ref = U_X[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
      U_cond_ref = U_X[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
      x_cond = u_Sjc,
      h = h_shap
    )

    out_mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = n_samp,
      ncol = length(Sj)
    )

    colnames(out_mat) <- xj_sel_Z[Sj]

    for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
      out_mat[, k] <- quantile(
        data_X[, Sj[k]],
        probs = pmin(
          pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6),
          1 - 1e-6
        ),
        names = FALSE
      )
    }

    out_mat
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat("\nEstimation des valeurs de Shapley X -> Z\n")
  }

  res_XZ <- shapleyPermEx(
    model = function(X) {
      predict_fn(model_obj, X)
    },
    Xall = Xall_fn,
    Xset = Xset_fn,
    d = d_shap,
    Nv = n,
    No = No,
    Ni = Ni,
    colnames = xj_sel_Z
  )

  out$res_shapley_XZ <- res_XZ

  # ==========================================================================
  # Tableau récapitulatif
  # ==========================================================================

  tau_XZ <- vapply(
    xj_sel_Z,
    function(xj) {
      cor(
        as.numeric(vars_all[, xj]),
        Z_vec,
        method = "kendall",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )
    },
    numeric(1)
  )

  shapley_est <- get_col(
    res_XZ$Shapley,
    col = 1
  )

  shapley_se <- get_col(
    res_XZ$Shapley,
    col = 3
  )

  sobol1_est <- get_col(
    res_XZ$SobolS,
    col = 1
  )

  sobolT_est <- get_col(
    res_XZ$SobolT,
    col = 1
  )

  recap_XZ <- data.frame(
    joueur = xj_sel_Z,
    tau_XZ = round(tau_XZ, 4),
    shapley_est = round(shapley_est, 4),
    shapley_se = round(shapley_se, 4),
    shapley_lo = round(
      shapley_est - 1.96 * shapley_se,
      4
    ),
    shapley_hi = round(
      shapley_est + 1.96 * shapley_se,
      4
    ),
    sobol1_est = round(sobol1_est, 4),
    sobolT_est = round(sobolT_est, 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out$recap_XZ <- recap_XZ
  out$tau_XZ <- tau_XZ

  if (verbose) {
    cat("\nTableau X -> Z\n")
    print(
      recap_XZ,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================================
  # Graphique Shapley et Sobol
  # ==========================================================================

  df_sh <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      joueur = xj_sel_Z,
      val = shapley_est,
      lo = shapley_est - 1.96 * shapley_se,
      hi = shapley_est + 1.96 * shapley_se,
      type = "Shapley"
    ),
    data.frame(
      joueur = xj_sel_Z,
      val = sobol1_est,
      lo = NA_real_,
      hi = NA_real_,
      type = "Sobol S1"
    ),
    data.frame(
      joueur = xj_sel_Z,
      val = sobolT_est,
      lo = NA_real_,
      hi = NA_real_,
      type = "Sobol ST"
    )
  )

  p_shapXZ <- ggplot(
    df_sh,
    aes(
      x = joueur,
      y = val,
      fill = type
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
      width = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = round(val, 3)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(
      palette = "Set2"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Shapley et Sobol : X -> Z",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "nu = ", nu,
        " | omega = ", omega,
        " | tau(Z, Z') = ",
        round(tau_ZZp, 4),
        " | copule Z ~ Z' : ",
        fit_check$family
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Indice",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  df_sobol <- df_sh %>%
    filter(
      type %in% c("Sobol S1", "Sobol ST")
    )

  p_sobolXZ <- ggplot(
    df_sobol,
    aes(
      x = joueur,
      y = val,
      fill = type
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
      width = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = round(val, 3)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
      vjust = -0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(
      palette = "Set2"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Indices de Sobol : X -> Z",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "nu = ", nu,
        " | omega = ", omega,
        " | tau(Z, Z') = ",
        round(tau_ZZp, 4),
        " | copule Z ~ Z' : ",
        fit_check$family
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Indice",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  out$plots <- list(
    p_shapXZ = p_shapXZ,
    p_sobolXZ = p_sobolXZ
  )

  print(p_shapXZ)
  print(p_sobolXZ)

  invisible(out)
}
```

```{r}

level_reduction_nonparametric_fig7 = function( #fonction pr le niveau Y Z dans systeme de xu et al

  vars_all,
  X_vars = c("X1","X2","X3","X4"),
  Y_vars = c("Y1","Y2","Y3"),

  model_Y1 = NULL,
  model_Y2 = NULL,
  model_Y3 = NULL,

  g_fun = function(X3, X4, Y1, Y2, Y3, omega)
    X4*Y1^omega + X4^2*Y2^omega + 2*X4^2*Y3^omega + 10*X4^2*X3^omega,

  omega = 2,
  nu = 2,

  tau_threshold = 0.10,
  sob_threshold = 0.20,

  nboot_sobol = 0,
  leave_one_out = TRUE,

  No = 50,
  Ni = 3,
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = 443

) {

  set.seed(seed)

  get_col = function(df, nm) as.numeric(df[[nm]])
  bandwidth_silverman = function(n, d) n^(-1/(d+4))
  pseudo_obs_manual = function(x)
    apply(as.matrix(x), 2, function(col) rank(col)/(length(col)+1))

  K_gauss = function(u, U_ref, h) {
    n = nrow(U_ref)
    w = numeric(n)
    for (k in seq_len(n)) {
      w[k] = prod(dnorm(u - U_ref[k,], mean = 0, sd = h))
    }
    w
  }

  F_cond_kde = function(v, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h) {
    w = K_gauss(u_X, U_Xs, h)
    w_sum = sum(w)
    if (w_sum < 1e-12) return(v)
    sum(w * (u_Ys <= v)) / w_sum
  }

  Q_cond_kde = function(u_Y, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h, tol = 1e-4) {
    f = function(v) F_cond_kde(v, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h) - u_Y
    f0 = f(tol)
    f1 = f(1 - tol)
    if (is.na(f0) || is.na(f1) || sign(f0) == sign(f1)) {
      grid = seq(tol, 1 - tol, length.out = 200)
      return(grid[which.min(abs(sapply(grid, f)))])
    }
    uniroot(f, lower = tol, upper = 1 - tol, tol = tol)$root
  }

  make_kde_model = function(joueurs, data_real, U_joueurs, h, omega) {
    list(
      joueurs = joueurs,
      data_real = as.data.frame(data_real),
      U_joueurs = as.matrix(U_joueurs),
      h = h,
      omega = omega,
      n = nrow(data_real)
    )
  }

  predict_kde_model = function(object, X) {
    X = as.matrix(X)
    colnames(X) = object$joueurs
    g_fun(
      X3 = X[, "X3"], X4 = X[, "X4"],
      Y1 = X[, "Y1"], Y2 = X[, "Y2"], Y3 = X[, "Y3"],
      omega = object$omega
    )
  }

  Xall_kde_model = function(object, n_samp) {
    idx = sample(object$n, n_samp, replace = TRUE)
    as.matrix(object$data_real[idx, , drop = FALSE])
  }

  Xset_kde_model = function(object, n_samp, Sj, Sjc, xjc) {
    if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
      idx = sample(object$n, n_samp, replace = TRUE)
      out = as.matrix(object$data_real[idx, Sj, drop = FALSE])
      colnames(out) = object$joueurs[Sj]
      return(out)
    }

    u_Sjc = numeric(length(Sjc))
    for (k in seq_along(Sjc)) {
      col_real = object$data_real[, Sjc[k]]
      u_Sjc[k] = mean(col_real <= xjc[k])
    }
    u_Sjc = pmin(pmax(u_Sjc, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)

    draw = sample_cond_kde(
      n_samp,
      object$U_joueurs[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
      object$U_joueurs[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
      u_Sjc,
      object$h
    )

    out = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_samp, ncol = length(Sj))
    colnames(out) = object$joueurs[Sj]

    for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
      col_real = object$data_real[, Sj[k]]
      out[, k] = quantile(col_real, probs = pmin(pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
    }
    out
  }

  extract_full = function(res, joueurs) {
    get_s = function(mat, col) {
      m = as.matrix(mat)
      if (ncol(m) >= col) as.numeric(m[, col]) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(m))
    }
    data.frame(
      joueur = joueurs,
      shapley_est = round(get_s(res$Shapley, 1), 4),
      shapley_se  = round(get_s(res$Shapley, 3), 4),
      shapley_lo  = round(get_s(res$Shapley, 1) - 1.96 * get_s(res$Shapley, 3), 4),
      shapley_hi  = round(get_s(res$Shapley, 1) + 1.96 * get_s(res$Shapley, 3), 4),
      sobol1_est  = round(get_s(res$SobolS, 1), 4),
      sobol1_se   = round(get_s(res$SobolS, 3), 4),
      sobolT_est  = round(get_s(res$SobolT, 1), 4),
      sobolT_se   = round(get_s(res$SobolT, 3), 4),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  extract_shapley = function(res) as.numeric(as.matrix(res$Shapley)[, 1])

  vars_all = as.data.frame(vars_all)
  colnames(vars_all) = trimws(colnames(vars_all))
  vn_all = colnames(vars_all)
  n = nrow(vars_all)

  U_all = pseudo_obs(as.matrix(vars_all))
  X_all = sapply(X_vars, get_col, df = vars_all)

  out = list()

  # ============================================================
  # 1) masque tau (inutile ds cet exemple, utile)
  # ============================================================
  tau_XY = matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(X_vars),
    ncol = length(Y_vars),
    dimnames = list(X_vars, Y_vars)
  )

  for (xj in X_vars) {
    for (yi in Y_vars) {
      tau_XY[xj, yi] = cor(
        get_col(vars_all, xj),
        get_col(vars_all, yi),
        method = "kendall",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )
    }
  }

  mask_tau = abs(tau_XY) > tau_threshold
  mask_tau[is.na(mask_tau)] = FALSE

  # ============================================================
  # 2) masque Sobol
  # ============================================================
  if (is.null(model_Y1) || is.null(model_Y2) || is.null(model_Y3)) {
    stop("model_Y1, model_Y2, model_Y3 requis pour la sélection Sobol")
  }

  n_half = floor(n / 2)

  sobY1 = sobolSalt(model = NULL, X1 = X_all[(n_half + 1):n, ], X2 = X_all[1:n_half, ], nboot = nboot_sobol)
  sobY2 = sobolSalt(model = NULL, X1 = X_all[(n_half + 1):n, ], X2 = X_all[1:n_half, ], nboot = nboot_sobol)
  sobY3 = sobolSalt(model = NULL, X1 = X_all[(n_half + 1):n, ], X2 = X_all[1:n_half, ], nboot = nboot_sobol)

  sobol_Y1 = tell(sobY1, model_Y1(sobY1$X))
  sobol_Y2 = tell(sobY2, model_Y2(sobY2$X))
  sobol_Y3 = tell(sobY3, model_Y3(sobY3$X))

  df_S = bind_rows(
    data.frame(var = rownames(sobol_Y1$S), sobol = sobol_Y1$S$original, sobol_T = sobol_Y1$T$original, systeme = "Y1"),
    data.frame(var = rownames(sobol_Y2$S), sobol = sobol_Y2$S$original, sobol_T = sobol_Y2$T$original, systeme = "Y2"),
    data.frame(var = rownames(sobol_Y3$S), sobol = sobol_Y3$S$original, sobol_T = sobol_Y3$T$original, systeme = "Y3")
  )

  sob_T = matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(X_vars),
    ncol = length(Y_vars),
    dimnames = list(X_vars, Y_vars)
  )

  for (xj in X_vars) {
    for (yi in Y_vars) {
      val = df_S %>% dplyr::filter(var == xj, systeme == yi) %>% dplyr::pull(sobol_T)
      sob_T[xj, yi] = if (length(val) > 0 && !is.na(val)) val else 0
    }
  }

  mask_sobol = sob_T > sob_threshold
  mask_sobol[is.na(mask_sobol)] = FALSE

  # ============================================================
  # 3) reconstruction tau
  # ============================================================
  recap_tau = data.frame(
    Yi = Y_vars,
    Xj_influents = NA_character_,
    h = NA_real_,
    famille_copule = NA_character_,
    tau_copule = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  Yprime_tau = list()

  for (yi in Y_vars) {
    xj_sel = rownames(mask_tau)[mask_tau[, yi]]
    xj_sel = xj_sel[!is.na(xj_sel) & xj_sel %in% vn_all]

    recap_tau$Xj_influents[recap_tau$Yi == yi] =
      if (length(xj_sel) == 0) "—" else paste(xj_sel, collapse = ", ")

    if (length(xj_sel) == 0L) {
      Yprime_tau[[yi]] = get_col(vars_all, yi)
      recap_tau$h[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = NA_real_
      recap_tau$famille_copule[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = "—"
      recap_tau$tau_copule[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = 1
      next
    }

    d_x = length(xj_sel)
    h = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_x)
    recap_tau$h[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = round(h, 4)

    idx_xj = match(xj_sel, vn_all)
    idx_yi = match(yi, vn_all)

    U_Xs = U_all[, idx_xj, drop = FALSE]
    u_Ys = U_all[, idx_yi]

    u_prime = numeric(n)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      idx_ref = if (leave_one_out) setdiff(seq_len(n), i) else seq_len(n)
      u_prime[i] = Q_cond_kde(
        u_Y = u_Ys[i],
        u_X = U_Xs[i, ],
        U_Xs = U_Xs[idx_ref, , drop = FALSE],
        u_Ys = u_Ys[idx_ref],
        h = h
      )
    }

    Yi_vals = get_col(vars_all, yi)
    Yprime_tau[[yi]] = as.numeric(quantile(Yi_vals, probs = pmin(pmax(u_prime, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)))

    U_check = pseudo_obs(cbind(Yi_vals, Yprime_tau[[yi]]))
    fit_check = bicop(U_check, family_set = "parametric", selcrit = "aic")
    tau_cop = fit_check$tau
    if (is.null(tau_cop) || !is.numeric(tau_cop)) {
      tau_cop = cor(U_check[, 1], U_check[, 2], method = "kendall")
    }

    recap_tau$famille_copule[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = fit_check$family
    recap_tau$tau_copule[recap_tau$Yi == yi] = round(tau_cop, 4)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 4) reconstruction sobol
  # ============================================================
  recap_sobol = data.frame(
    Yi = Y_vars,
    Xj_influents = NA_character_,
    h = NA_real_,
    famille_copule = NA_character_,
    tau_copule = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  Yprime_sobol = list()

  for (yi in Y_vars) {
    xj_sel = rownames(mask_sobol)[mask_sobol[, yi]]
    xj_sel = xj_sel[!is.na(xj_sel) & xj_sel %in% vn_all]

    recap_sobol$Xj_influents[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] =
      if (length(xj_sel) == 0) "—" else paste(xj_sel, collapse = ", ")

    if (length(xj_sel) == 0L) {
      Yprime_sobol[[yi]] = get_col(vars_all, yi)
      recap_sobol$h[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = NA_real_
      recap_sobol$famille_copule[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = "—"
      recap_sobol$tau_copule[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = 1
      next
    }

    d_x = length(xj_sel)
    h = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_x)
    recap_sobol$h[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = round(h, 4)

    idx_xj = match(xj_sel, vn_all)
    idx_yi = match(yi, vn_all)

    U_Xs = U_all[, idx_xj, drop = FALSE]
    u_Ys = U_all[, idx_yi]

    u_prime = numeric(n)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      idx_ref = if (leave_one_out) setdiff(seq_len(n), i) else seq_len(n)
      u_prime[i] = Q_cond_kde(
        u_Y = u_Ys[i],
        u_X = U_Xs[i, ],
        U_Xs = U_Xs[idx_ref, , drop = FALSE],
        u_Ys = u_Ys[idx_ref],
        h = h
      )
    }

    Yi_vals = get_col(vars_all, yi)
    Yprime_sobol[[yi]] = as.numeric(quantile(Yi_vals, probs = pmin(pmax(u_prime, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)))

    U_check = pseudo_obs(cbind(Yi_vals, Yprime_sobol[[yi]]))
    fit_check = bicop(U_check, family_set = "parametric", selcrit = "aic")
    tau_cop = fit_check$tau
    if (is.null(tau_cop) || !is.numeric(tau_cop)) {
      tau_cop = cor(U_check[, 1], U_check[, 2], method = "kendall")
    }

    recap_sobol$famille_copule[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = fit_check$family
    recap_sobol$tau_copule[recap_sobol$Yi == yi] = round(tau_cop, 4)
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 5) reconstruction Z et Shapley
  # ============================================================
  X3 = get_col(vars_all, "X3")
  X4 = get_col(vars_all, "X4")
  Z  = get_col(vars_all, "Z")

  Y1p_tau = as.numeric(Yprime_tau[["Y1"]])
  Y2p_tau = as.numeric(Yprime_tau[["Y2"]])
  Y3p_tau = as.numeric(Yprime_tau[["Y3"]])

  Y1p_sob = as.numeric(Yprime_sobol[["Y1"]])
  Y2p_sob = as.numeric(Yprime_sobol[["Y2"]])
  Y3p_sob = as.numeric(Yprime_sobol[["Y3"]])

  Z_tau = g_fun(X3 = X3, X4 = X4, Y1 = Y1p_tau, Y2 = Y2p_tau, Y3 = Y3p_tau, omega = omega)
  Z_sob = g_fun(X3 = X3, X4 = X4, Y1 = Y1p_sob, Y2 = Y2p_sob, Y3 = Y3p_sob, omega = omega)

  tau_Z_tau = cor(Z, Z_tau, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs")
  tau_Z_sob = cor(Z, Z_sob, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs")

  h_5 = bandwidth_silverman(n, 5)
  joueurs = c("Y1", "Y2", "Y3", "X3", "X4")

  data_Y = data.frame(Y1 = get_col(vars_all, "Y1"), Y2 = get_col(vars_all, "Y2"),
                      Y3 = get_col(vars_all, "Y3"), X3 = X3, X4 = X4)
  model_Y_obj = make_kde_model(joueurs, data_Y, pseudo_obs_manual(data_Y), h_5, omega)

  data_Ytau = data.frame(Y1 = Y1p_tau, Y2 = Y2p_tau, Y3 = Y3p_tau, X3 = X3, X4 = X4)
  model_Ytau_obj = make_kde_model(joueurs, data_Ytau, pseudo_obs_manual(data_Ytau), h_5, omega)

  data_Ysob = data.frame(Y1 = Y1p_sob, Y2 = Y2p_sob, Y3 = Y3p_sob, X3 = X3, X4 = X4)
  model_Ysob_obj = make_kde_model(joueurs, data_Ysob, pseudo_obs_manual(data_Ysob), h_5, omega)

  res_shapley_Y = shapleyPermEx(
    model = function(X) predict_kde_model(model_Y_obj, X),
    Xall = function(n_s) Xall_kde_model(model_Y_obj, n_s),
    Xset = function(n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc) Xset_kde_model(model_Y_obj, n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc),
    d = 5, Nv = n, No = No, Ni = Ni, colnames = joueurs
  )

  res_shapley_Ytau = shapleyPermEx(
    model = function(X) predict_kde_model(model_Ytau_obj, X),
    Xall = function(n_s) Xall_kde_model(model_Ytau_obj, n_s),
    Xset = function(n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc) Xset_kde_model(model_Ytau_obj, n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc),
    d = 5, Nv = n, No = No, Ni = Ni, colnames = joueurs
  )

  res_shapley_Ysob = shapleyPermEx(
    model = function(X) predict_kde_model(model_Ysob_obj, X),
    Xall = function(n_s) Xall_kde_model(model_Ysob_obj, n_s),
    Xset = function(n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc) Xset_kde_model(model_Ysob_obj, n_s, Sj, Sjc, xjc),
    d = 5, Nv = n, No = No, Ni = Ni, colnames = joueurs
  )

  sh_Y = extract_shapley(res_shapley_Y)
  sh_Ytau = extract_shapley(res_shapley_Ytau)
  sh_Ysob = extract_shapley(res_shapley_Ysob)

  df_compare_tau = data.frame(var = joueurs, shapley = sh_Ytau)

  df_compare_sob =data.frame(var = joueurs, shapley = sh_Ysob)

  # ============================================================
  # 6) tableaux récapitulatifs
  # ============================================================
  out$mask_tau = mask_tau
  out$mask_sobol = mask_sobol
  out$recap_tau = recap_tau
  out$recap_sobol = recap_sobol
  out$Yprime_tau = Yprime_tau
  out$Yprime_sobol = Yprime_sobol
  out$Z_tau = Z_tau
  out$Z_sob = Z_sob
  out$tau_Z_tau = tau_Z_tau
  out$tau_Z_sob = tau_Z_sob
  out$res_shapley_Y = res_shapley_Y
  out$res_shapley_Ytau = res_shapley_Ytau
  out$res_shapley_Ysob = res_shapley_Ysob
  out$df_compare_tau = df_compare_tau
  out$df_compare_sob = df_compare_sob

  # ============================================================
  # 7) visualisations
  # ============================================================
  df_tau_mat = reshape2::melt(tau_XY)
  colnames(df_tau_mat) = c("Xj", "Yi", "tau")
  df_tau_mat$influent = abs(df_tau_mat$tau) > tau_threshold
  df_tau_mat$influent[is.na(df_tau_mat$influent)] = FALSE
  df_tau_mat$label = ifelse(is.na(df_tau_mat$tau), "", round(df_tau_mat$tau, 3))

  p_tau = ggplot(df_tau_mat, aes(x = Yi, y = Xj, fill = tau)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), fontface = ifelse(!df_tau_mat$influent, "plain", "bold"), size = 3.2) +
    geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(df_tau_mat, !influent), aes(x = Yi, y = Xj),
              fill = NA, color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "#91bfdb", high = "#d73027",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "τ Kendall") +
    labs(title = paste0("Sélection Xj → Yi — seuil |τ| > ", tau_threshold),
         subtitle = "τ de Kendall empirique", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  df_sob_mat = reshape2::melt(sob_T)
  colnames(df_sob_mat) = c("Xj", "Yi", "sobolT")
  df_sob_mat$influent = df_sob_mat$sobolT > sob_threshold
  df_sob_mat$influent[is.na(df_sob_mat$influent)] = FALSE
  df_sob_mat$label = ifelse(is.na(df_sob_mat$sobolT), "", round(df_sob_mat$sobolT, 3))

  p_sobol = ggplot(df_sob_mat, aes(x = Yi, y = Xj, fill = sobolT)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), fontface = ifelse(!df_sob_mat$influent, "plain", "bold"), size = 3.2) +
    geom_tile(data = dplyr::filter(df_sob_mat, !influent), aes(x = Yi, y = Xj),
              fill = NA, color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "white", mid = "#91bfdb", high = "#d73027",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(0, 1), name = "T Sobol") +
    labs(title = paste0("Sélection Xj → Yi — seuil T > ", sob_threshold),
         subtitle = "Indices de Sobol totaux", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  df_tauZ_tau = data.frame(
    groupe = rep(c("Original", "Tau"), each = 4),
    var = rep(c("Y1", "Y2", "Y3", "X4"), 2),
    tau = c(
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y1"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y2"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y3"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "X4"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y1p_tau, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y2p_tau, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y3p_tau, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "X4"), method = "kendall")
    )
  )

  p_tauZ = ggplot(df_tauZ_tau, aes(x = var, y = tau, fill = groupe)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(tau, 3)),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(title = "τ(Z, .) — Original vs reconstruction tau",
         x = NULL, y = "τ", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  df_tauZ_sob = data.frame(
    groupe = rep(c("Original", "Sobol"), each = 4),
    var = rep(c("Y1", "Y2", "Y3", "X4"), 2),
    tau = c(
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y1"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y2"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "Y3"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "X4"), method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y1p_sob, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y2p_sob, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, Y3p_sob, method = "kendall"),
      cor(Z, get_col(vars_all, "X4"), method = "kendall")
    )
  )

  p_tauZ_sob = ggplot(df_tauZ_sob, aes(x = var, y = tau, fill = groupe)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(tau, 3)),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(title = "τ(Z, .) — Original vs reconstruction Sobol",
         x = NULL, y = "τ", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  p3_sob <- ggplot(df_compare_sob, aes(x = var, y = shapley)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(shapley, 4)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Valeurs de Shapley — (Y',X3,X4)→Z",
    subtitle = "Variables influentes choisies par Sobol",
    y = "Valeurs de Shapley",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

  out$plots = list(
    p_tau = p_tau,
    p_sobol = p_sobol,
    p_tauZ = p_tauZ,
    p_tauZ_sob = p_tauZ_sob,
    p_shapley_sob = p3_sob
  )

  out
}
```

### Système en cascade

```{r}

library(rvinecopulib)
library(sensitivity)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(443)
n = 10000

# ── Noms des entrées globales ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
X_names = paste0("X", 1:16)

# ── Génération des entrées globales U[0,1] ────────────────────────────────────
X_mat = matrix(runif(n * 16), nrow = n, ncol = 16,
               dimnames = list(NULL, X_names))
X_df  = as.data.frame(X_mat)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SOUS-MODÈLES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Solver 1 : G-function ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
a_gfun = c(12, 2, 3, 4, 45)

solver1 = function(X) {
  apply(X, 1, function(xrow)
    prod(sapply(seq_along(a_gfun), function(k)
      (abs(4*xrow[k] - 2) + a_gfun[k]) / (1 + a_gfun[k])))
  )
}

# ── Solver 2 : Ishigami ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
solver2 = function(Y1, X6, X7)
  sin(Y1) + 7*sin(X6)^2 + 0.1*X7^4*sin(Y1)

# ── Solver 3 : polynôme + arctan ─────────────────────────────────────────────
solver3 = function(Y2, X8, X9, X10, X11, X12)
  X9^2 * atan(1 - X12) + X10*X11*X8^3 + 3*Y2

# ── Solver 4 (sortie Z) : sinus + produit ────────────────────────────────────
solver4 = function(Y3, X13, X14, X15, X16)
  sin(X16)*X15 + Y3*X13 + X14

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CALCUL DES NIVEAUX
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Y1 = solver1(X_mat[, 1:5, drop = FALSE])
Y2 = solver2(Y1, X_mat[,"X6"], X_mat[,"X7"])
Y3 = solver3(Y2, X_mat[,"X8"], X_mat[,"X9"],
             X_mat[,"X10"], X_mat[,"X11"], X_mat[,"X12"])
Z  = solver4(Y3, X_mat[,"X13"], X_mat[,"X14"],
             X_mat[,"X15"], X_mat[,"X16"])

cat("── Statistiques ──\n")
cat("Y1 : mean =", round(mean(Y1),4), "| sd =", round(sd(Y1),4), "\n")
cat("Y2 : mean =", round(mean(Y2),4), "| sd =", round(sd(Y2),4), "\n")
cat("Y3 : mean =", round(mean(Y3),4), "| sd =", round(sd(Y3),4), "\n")
cat("Z  : mean =", round(mean(Z), 4), "| sd =", round(sd(Z), 4),  "\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FONCTIONS AUXILIAIRES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

bandwidth_silverman = function(n, d) n^(-1/(d+4))

pseudo_obs_manual = function(x) {
  m = apply(as.matrix(x), 2, function(col) rank(col)/(length(col)+1))
  colnames(m) = colnames(as.matrix(x))
  m
}

K_gauss = function(u, U_ref, h) {
  nr = nrow(U_ref); w = numeric(nr)
  for (k in seq_len(nr))
    w[k] = prod(dnorm(u - U_ref[k,], 0, h))
  w
}

F_cond_kde = function(v, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h) {
  w = K_gauss(u_X, U_Xs, h); ws = sum(w)
  if (is.na(ws) || ws < 1e-12) return(v)
  sum(w * (u_Ys <= v), na.rm = TRUE) / ws
}

Q_cond_kde = function(u_Y, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h, tol = 1e-4) {
  f  = function(v) F_cond_kde(v, u_X, U_Xs, u_Ys, h) - u_Y
  f0 = f(tol); f1 = f(1 - tol)
  if (is.na(f0) || is.na(f1) || sign(f0) == sign(f1)) {
    grid = seq(tol, 1 - tol, length.out = 200)
    return(grid[which.min(abs(sapply(grid, f)))])
  }
  uniroot(f, lower = tol, upper = 1 - tol, tol = tol)$root
}

sample_cond_kde = function(Ni_s, U_tgt, U_cnd, x_cnd, h) {
  nr = nrow(U_cnd)
  if (is.null(x_cnd) || length(x_cnd) == 0L) {
    idx = sample(nr, Ni_s, replace = TRUE)
    return(list(idx = idx, vals = U_tgt[idx, , drop = FALSE]))
  }
  w = K_gauss(x_cnd, U_cnd, h); ws = sum(w)
  idx = if (ws < 1e-12) sample(nr, Ni_s, replace = TRUE) else
        sample(nr, Ni_s, replace = TRUE, prob = w / ws)
  list(idx = idx, vals = U_tgt[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

construire_Yprime = function(Y_vec, U_cond, u_Y, h, n_obs, nm = "Y") {
  u_p = numeric(n_obs)
  cat("  Construction", nm, "| h =", round(h, 4), "...\n")
  pct = unique(pmax(1L, floor(seq(1, n_obs, length.out = 11))))
  for (i in seq_len(n_obs)) {
    if (i %in% pct) cat(round(100 * i / n_obs), "%  ", sep = "")
    ref = setdiff(seq_len(n_obs), i)
    u_p[i] = Q_cond_kde(u_Y[i], U_cond[i, ],
                        U_cond[ref, , drop = FALSE], u_Y[ref], h)
  }; cat("\n")
  as.numeric(quantile(Y_vec, probs = pmin(pmax(u_p, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)))
}

diagnostic_copule = function(Y_orig, Y_prime, nm = "Y") {
  tau_e = cor(Y_orig, Y_prime, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs")
  Uc    = pseudo_obs(cbind(Y_orig, Y_prime))
  fit   = bicop(Uc, family_set = "parametric", selcrit = "aic")
  tc    = fit$tau
  if (is.null(tc) || !is.numeric(tc))
    tc  = cor(Uc[,1], Uc[,2], method = "kendall")
  cat("  τ(", nm, ",", nm, "') =", round(tau_e, 4),
      "| copule:", fit$family, "| τ_cop =", round(tc, 4), "\n")
  list(tau_emp = round(tau_e, 4), famille = fit$family, tau_cop = round(tc, 4))
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ÉTAPE 1 : Sobol X → Y1 (niveau 1)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════ ÉTAPE 1 : Sobol X1..X5 → Y1 (G-function) ════\n")

n_half = floor(n / 2)
X1_5   = X_mat[, 1:5, drop = FALSE]
colnames(X1_5) = paste0("X", 1:5)

sob_Y1 = sobolmartinez(model = solver1,
                   X1 = X1_5[(n_half + 1):n, , drop = FALSE],
                   X2 = X1_5[1:n_half, , drop = FALSE],
                   nboot = 0)

cat("Indices Sobol ST (X → Y1) :\n")
print(round(sob_Y1$T$original, 4))

delta_S = 0.2
mask_Y1 = paste0("X", which(sob_Y1$T$original > delta_S))
cat("Xj influents sur Y1 (S^T >", delta_S, ") :",
    paste(mask_Y1, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Construction Y1'
U_all = pseudo_obs_manual(cbind(X_df, Y1 = Y1, Y2 = Y2, Y3 = Y3, Z = Z))
idx_xj_Y1 = match(mask_Y1, colnames(U_all))
idx_y1    = match("Y1", colnames(U_all))

h_Y1 = bandwidth_silverman(n, length(mask_Y1))
Y1p  = construire_Yprime(Y1, U_all[, idx_xj_Y1, drop = FALSE],
                         U_all[, idx_y1], h_Y1, n, nm = "Y1")
diag_Y1 = diagnostic_copule(Y1, Y1p, nm = "Y1")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ÉTAPE 2 : Shapley (Y1', X6, X7) → Y2, puis construction Y2'
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════ ÉTAPE 2 : Shapley (Y1', X6, X7) → Y2 ════\n")

data_Y2 = data.frame(Y1p = Y1p,
                     X6   = X_mat[,"X6"],
                     X7   = X_mat[,"X7"])
joueurs_Y2 = colnames(data_Y2)
d_Y2       = length(joueurs_Y2)
h_Y2_kde   = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_Y2)

U_Y2 = pseudo_obs_manual(data_Y2)
u_y2 = pseudo_obs_manual(data.frame(Y2 = Y2))[, 1]

# Modèle KDE : E[Y2 | joueurs_Y2 = x]
model_Y2 = function(Xn) {
  Xn = as.matrix(Xn)
  apply(Xn, 1, function(xr) {
    ux = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_len(d_Y2), function(k)
                mean(data_Y2[, k] <= xr[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
    w = K_gauss(ux, U_Y2, h_Y2_kde); ws = sum(w)
    if (ws < 1e-12) return(mean(Y2))
    sum(w * Y2) / ws
  })
}

Xall_Y2 = function(ns) {
  idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
  as.matrix(data_Y2[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

Xset_Y2 = function(ns, Sj, Sjc, xjc) {
  if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
    idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
    om  = as.matrix(data_Y2[idx, Sj, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(om) = joueurs_Y2[Sj]; return(om)
  }
  u_Sjc = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_along(Sjc), function(k)
               mean(data_Y2[, Sjc[k]] <= xjc[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  draw  = sample_cond_kde(ns,
                          U_Y2[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
                          U_Y2[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
                          u_Sjc, h_Y2_kde)
  om = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ns, ncol = length(Sj))
  colnames(om) = joueurs_Y2[Sj]
  for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
    cr = data_Y2[, Sj[k]]
    om[, k] = quantile(cr, probs = pmin(pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
  }
  om
}

set.seed(443)
res_sh_Y2 = shapleyPermEx(
  model    = model_Y2,
  Xall     = Xall_Y2,
  Xset     = Xset_Y2,
  d        = d_Y2,
  Nv       = n,
  No       = 50,
  Ni       = 3,
  colnames = joueurs_Y2
)

get_s = function(mat, col) {
  m = as.matrix(mat)
  if (ncol(m) >= col) as.numeric(m[, col]) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(m))
}

sh_Y2_est = get_s(res_sh_Y2$Shapley, 1)
names(sh_Y2_est) = joueurs_Y2
cat("Valeurs de Shapley (Y1', X6, X7) → Y2 :\n")
print(round(sh_Y2_est, 4))

# Seuil Shapley (par exemple 0.10)
delta_Sh_Y2 = 0.10
mask_Y2 = joueurs_Y2[sh_Y2_est > delta_Sh_Y2]
cat("Joueurs retenus pour Y2 (Shapley >", delta_Sh_Y2, ") :",
    paste(mask_Y2, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Construction Y2'
idx_xj_Y2 = match(mask_Y2, colnames(U_all))
idx_y2    = match("Y2", colnames(U_all))

h_Y2 = bandwidth_silverman(n, length(mask_Y2))
Y2p  = construire_Yprime(Y2, U_all[, idx_xj_Y2, drop = FALSE],
                         U_all[, idx_y2], h_Y2, n, nm = "Y2")
diag_Y2 = diagnostic_copule(Y2, Y2p, nm = "Y2")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ÉTAPE 3 : Shapley (Y2', X8..X12) → Y3, puis construction Y3'
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════ ÉTAPE 3 : Shapley (Y2', X8..X12) → Y3 ════\n")

data_Y3 = data.frame(Y2p = Y2p,
                     X8   = X_mat[,"X8"],
                     X9   = X_mat[,"X9"],
                     X10  = X_mat[,"X10"],
                     X11  = X_mat[,"X11"],
                     X12  = X_mat[,"X12"])
joueurs_Y3 = colnames(data_Y3)
d_Y3       = length(joueurs_Y3)
h_Y3_kde   = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_Y3)

U_Y3 = pseudo_obs_manual(data_Y3)
u_y3 = pseudo_obs_manual(Y3)

# ── Suite à partir de l'étape 3 ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Modèle KDE : E[Y3 | joueurs_Y3 = x]
model_Y3 = function(Xn) {
  Xn = as.matrix(Xn)
  apply(Xn, 1, function(xr) {
    ux = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_len(d_Y3), function(k)
                mean(data_Y3[, k] <= xr[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
    w = K_gauss(ux, U_Y3, h_Y3_kde); ws = sum(w)
    if (ws < 1e-12) return(mean(Y3))
    sum(w * Y3) / ws
  })
}

Xall_Y3 = function(ns) {
  idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
  as.matrix(data_Y3[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

Xset_Y3 = function(ns, Sj, Sjc, xjc) {
  if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
    idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
    om  = as.matrix(data_Y3[idx, Sj, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(om) = joueurs_Y3[Sj]; return(om)
  }
  u_Sjc = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_along(Sjc), function(k)
               mean(data_Y3[, Sjc[k]] <= xjc[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  draw  = sample_cond_kde(ns,
                          U_Y3[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
                          U_Y3[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
                          u_Sjc, h_Y3_kde)
  om = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ns, ncol = length(Sj))
  colnames(om) = joueurs_Y3[Sj]
  for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
    cr = data_Y3[, Sj[k]]
    om[, k] = quantile(cr, probs = pmin(pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
  }
  om
}

set.seed(443)
res_sh_Y3 = shapleyPermEx(
  model    = model_Y3,
  Xall     = Xall_Y3,
  Xset     = Xset_Y3,
  d        = d_Y3,
  Nv       = n,
  No       = 50,
  Ni       = 3,
  colnames = joueurs_Y3
)

sh_Y3_est = get_s(res_sh_Y3$Shapley, 1)
names(sh_Y3_est) = joueurs_Y3
cat("Valeurs de Shapley (Y2', X8..X12) → Y3 :\n")
print(round(sh_Y3_est, 4))

delta_Sh_Y3 = 0.1
mask_Y3 = joueurs_Y3[sh_Y3_est > delta_Sh_Y3]
cat("Joueurs retenus pour Y3 (Shapley >", delta_Sh_Y3, ") :",
    paste(mask_Y3, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Construction Y3'
idx_xj_Y3 = match(mask_Y3, colnames(U_all))
idx_y3    = match("Y3", colnames(U_all))

h_Y3 = bandwidth_silverman(n, length(mask_Y3))
Y3p  = construire_Yprime(Y3, U_all[, idx_xj_Y3, drop = FALSE],
                         U_all[, idx_y3], h_Y3, n, nm = "Y3")
diag_Y3 = diagnostic_copule(Y3, Y3p, nm = "Y3")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RECONSTRUCTION Z' et diagnostic
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════ Reconstruction Z' ════\n")

Zprime   = solver4(Y3p, X_mat[,"X13"], X_mat[,"X14"],
                   X_mat[,"X15"], X_mat[,"X16"])
tau_ZZp  = cor(Z, Zprime, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs")
delta_Z  = (Zprime - Z) / ifelse(Z == 0, NA, Z)

Uc_ZZp   = pseudo_obs(cbind(Z, Zprime))
fit_ZZp  = bicop(Uc_ZZp, family_set = "parametric", selcrit = "aic")
tau_cop_ZZp = fit_ZZp$tau
if (is.null(tau_cop_ZZp) || !is.numeric(tau_cop_ZZp))
  tau_cop_ZZp = cor(Uc_ZZp[,1], Uc_ZZp[,2], method = "kendall")

cat("τ(Z, Z') =", round(tau_ZZp, 4), "\n")
cat("Copule Z~Z' :", fit_ZZp$family, "| τ_cop =", round(tau_cop_ZZp, 4), "\n")
cat("Erreur relative mean|δZ| =",
    round(mean(abs(delta_Z), na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ÉTAPE 4 : Analyse directe X → Z (KDE + Shapley)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════ ÉTAPE 4 : Analyse directe X → Z ════\n")

# On utilise toutes les entrées X1..X16 comme joueurs
joueurs_XZ = X_names
d_XZ       = length(joueurs_XZ)
h_XZ_kde   = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_XZ)

U_XZ = pseudo_obs_manual(X_df)
u_z  = pseudo_obs_manual(data.frame(Z = Z))[, 1]

# Modèle KDE : E[Z | X_S = x]
model_XZ = function(Xn) {
  Xn = as.matrix(Xn)
  apply(Xn, 1, function(xr) {
    ux = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_len(d_XZ), function(k)
                mean(X_df[, k] <= xr[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
    w = K_gauss(ux, U_XZ, h_XZ_kde); ws = sum(w)
    if (ws < 1e-12) return(mean(Z))
    sum(w * Z) / ws
  })
}

Xall_XZ = function(ns) {
  idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
  as.matrix(X_df[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

Xset_XZ = function(ns, Sj, Sjc, xjc) {
  if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
    idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
    om  = as.matrix(X_df[idx, Sj, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(om) = joueurs_XZ[Sj]; return(om)
  }
  u_Sjc = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_along(Sjc), function(k)
               mean(X_df[, Sjc[k]] <= xjc[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  draw  = sample_cond_kde(ns,
                          U_XZ[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
                          U_XZ[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
                          u_Sjc, h_XZ_kde)
  om = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ns, ncol = length(Sj))
  colnames(om) = joueurs_XZ[Sj]
  for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
    cr = X_df[, Sj[k]]
    om[, k] = quantile(cr, probs = pmin(pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
  }
  om
}

# Ici, d = 16 → 16! trop grand → on utilise shapleyPermRand (MC sur m permutations)
set.seed(443)
res_sh_XZ = shapleyPermRand(
  model    = model_XZ,
  Xall     = Xall_XZ,
  Xset     = Xset_XZ,
  d        = d_XZ,
  Nv       = n,
  m        = 200,
  No       = 50,
  Ni       = 3,
  colnames = joueurs_XZ
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TABLEAUX RÉCAPITULATIFS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Tableau 1 : diagnostic Yi → Yi' ─────────────────────────────────────────
tab_diag = data.frame(
  Solver      = c("Solver 1", "Solver 2", "Solver 3"),

  Xj_retenus  = c(paste(mask_Y1, collapse = ","),
                  paste(mask_Y2, collapse = ","),
                  paste(mask_Y3, collapse = ",")),
  h           = round(c(h_Y1, h_Y2, h_Y3), 4),
  tau_Yi_Yip  = c(diag_Y1$tau_emp, diag_Y2$tau_emp, diag_Y3$tau_emp),
  copule      = c(diag_Y1$famille, diag_Y2$famille, diag_Y3$famille),
  tau_cop     = c(diag_Y1$tau_cop, diag_Y2$tau_cop, diag_Y3$tau_cop),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\n══ Tableau 1 — Diagnostic Yi → Yi' ══\n")
print(tab_diag, row.names = FALSE)

# ── Tableau 2 : Shapley final (Y3', X13..X16) → Z ───────────────────────────
# (optionnel, si tu veux aussi ce niveau intermédiaire)
joueurs_Z = c("Y3p", "X13", "X14", "X15", "X16")
d_Z       = length(joueurs_Z)
h_Z_kde   = bandwidth_silverman(n, d_Z)

data_Z    = data.frame(Y3p = Y3p,
                       X13  = X_mat[,"X13"],
                       X14  = X_mat[,"X14"],
                       X15  = X_mat[,"X15"],
                       X16  = X_mat[,"X16"])

U_Z = pseudo_obs_manual(data_Z)
u_zZ = pseudo_obs_manual(data.frame(Z = Z))[, 1]

model_Z = function(Xn) {
  Xn = as.matrix(Xn)
  apply(Xn, 1, function(xr) {
    ux = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_len(d_Z), function(k)
                mean(data_Z[, k] <= xr[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
    w = K_gauss(ux, U_Z, h_Z_kde); ws = sum(w)
    if (ws < 1e-12) return(mean(Z))
    sum(w * Z) / ws
  })
}

Xall_Z = function(ns) {
  idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
  as.matrix(data_Z[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

Xset_Z = function(ns, Sj, Sjc, xjc) {
  if (length(Sjc) == 0L) {
    idx = sample(n, ns, replace = TRUE)
    om  = as.matrix(data_Z[idx, Sj, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(om) = joueurs_Z[Sj]; return(om)
  }
  u_Sjc = pmin(pmax(sapply(seq_along(Sjc), function(k)
               mean(data_Z[, Sjc[k]] <= xjc[k])), 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
  draw  = sample_cond_kde(ns,
                          U_Z[, Sj, drop = FALSE],
                          U_Z[, Sjc, drop = FALSE],
                          u_Sjc, h_Z_kde)
  om = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ns, ncol = length(Sj))
  colnames(om) = joueurs_Z[Sj]
  for (k in seq_along(Sj)) {
    cr = data_Z[, Sj[k]]
    om[, k] = quantile(cr, probs = pmin(pmax(draw$vals[, k], 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6))
  }
  om
}

set.seed(443)
res_sh_Z = shapleyPermEx(
  model    = model_Z,
  Xall     = Xall_Z,
  Xset     = Xset_Z,
  d        = d_Z,
  Nv       = n,
  No       = 50,
  Ni       = 3,
  colnames = joueurs_Z
)

tau_Xj_Z = sapply(joueurs_Z, function(j)
  cor(data_Z[[j]], Z, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs"))

tab_sh = data.frame(
  joueur      = joueurs_Z,
  nature      = c("Y3' (enrichi)", rep("X direct", 4)),
  tau_Z       = round(tau_Xj_Z, 4),
  shapley_est = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 1), 4),
  shapley_se  = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 3), 4),
  shapley_lo  = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 1) -
                      1.96 * get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 3), 4),
  shapley_hi  = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 1) +
                      1.96 * get_s(res_sh_Z$Shapley, 3), 4),
  sobol1      = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$SobolS, 1), 4),
  sobolT      = round(get_s(res_sh_Z$SobolT, 1), 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\n══ Tableau 2 — Shapley (Y3', X13..X16) → Z ══\n")
print(tab_sh, row.names = FALSE)

# ── Tableau 3 : Shapley direct X → Z ─────────────────────────────────────────
tau_Xj_Z_direct = sapply(joueurs_XZ, function(j)
  cor(X_df[[j]], Z, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs"))

tab_sh_XZ = data.frame(
  joueur      = joueurs_XZ,

  shapley_lo  = round(get_s(res_sh_XZ$Shapley, 1) -
                      1.96 * get_s(res_sh_XZ$Shapley, 3), 4),
  shapley_hi  = round(get_s(res_sh_XZ$Shapley, 1) +
                      1.96 * get_s(res_sh_XZ$Shapley, 3), 4),
  sobol1      = round(get_s(res_sh_XZ$SobolS, 1), 4),
  sobolT      = round(get_s(res_sh_XZ$SobolT, 1), 4),

cat("\n══ Tableau 3 — Shapley direct X → Z ══\n")
print(tab_sh_XZ, row.names = FALSE)

# ── p2 : Shapley Y1' → Y2 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```
